description: Narrows code.structure.json for docs/code/python-*.md, which is applied as well. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/code-python.md; a python document's rule sections are named by their rules, so this file adds only the fixed type and the scopes allowed in the frontmatter, and that References is not optional here. Where References sits is code.structure.json's business.

type.$comment: A python-* document says how Python source is written, which is always core. A code spec about packaging, distribution shape, or build configuration governs where code lives instead, and belongs under a prefix that names that subject.

scope.$comment: global, or the package URL of the one dependency a python-* document is about, as in pkg:pypi/typer.

outline.description: Links to the document's neighbours, one entry each: a parent it specializes as Extends, first in the list; siblings as Related; a principle document as Foundation. Each description says what the reader gets by following the link.
examples:
- [python-fn](python-fn.md) - Extends: Owns parameter kinds and defaults of the functions named here
- [python-fn-conv](python-fn-conv.md) - Related: Owns `as_`/`to_`, `from_`/`parse_`/`load_`, and `with_`
- [python-fn-unchecked](python-fn-unchecked.md) - Related: Owns the `_unchecked` constructor and its proof
- [python-naming](python-naming.md) - Related: Owns casing and the leading-underscore privacy boundary
- [principle-least-surprise](principle-least-surprise.md) - Foundation: Why a name that contradicts its cost
  or its effect is a defect
